lead: A Mermaid diagram: a header with the title, a view-source and a copy button, and the rendered diagram below. The library doesn't bundle Mermaid: you pass in the render function. The result goes into an `` as an image, so no SVG is injected into the page. It re-renders when the light / dark mode changes, and shows a loading and an error state.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: On this page Mermaid is loaded on demand (dynamic `import()`), downloaded only when a diagram is shown.

error.title: Error
error.description: A syntax error shows the error message next to the source.

markdown.title: In Markdown
markdown.description: `codeRenderers` turns `mermaid` fenced code into a diagram. While streaming, an unclosed fence shows as a plain code block and is rendered once the fence closes. Pass a stable object.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: Root (`figure`); `data-state`: loading / ready / error, `data-view`: diagram / source
styling.body: The diagram's scroll area (focusable) and its ``; `data-stale` while the previous diagram is kept
